heading: Measuring instruments and spares
metaDescription: Measuring instruments, gauges and spares from JIE. Enquire on WhatsApp for specifications and pricing, with calibration and repair support.
intro: JIE supplies measuring instruments and spares from leading brands, and provides calibration, expert repair and servicing for all major brands of measuring instruments.
Tell us the instrument, gauge or spare part you need and the team will reply with specifications and pricing.
